summary: Implemented a default-off selected namespaced Pod/ConfigMap literal reader with bounded exact authenticated native GETs, stable identity/version checks, both pinned offline engines, shared HMAC fingerprints and union redaction before snapshots. The new exact-file native matrix and affected existing Kubernetes collector tests pass.

public_contract.exposure: potential; no effective access or credential-validity claim
public_contract.title: Selected Pod and ConfigMap literals have no detected secrets
guards: content_secret_scans must be strict boolean true
exact check ID must be explicitly named; category/framework/all selection and spoofed internal options cannot authorize content reads
1-8 unique selectors with exactly cluster_id, namespace, kind and name
Pod or ConfigMap only; exact DNS-safe names and explicit requested namespace scopes, never wildcard scope
selector cluster_id equals the existing configured collector cluster binding
native GET identity apiVersion=v1, exact kind/namespace/name, nonempty opaque UID/resourceVersion and no deletion or partial marker
two native reads must agree on UID/resourceVersion and selected content
both pinned engines complete; every selected resource represented by complete collection membership and safe matching receipts
supported: regular, init and ephemeral container literal env values, command and args
ConfigMap data and base64 binaryData that decodes to bounded UTF-8 text
selected native object identities, container/env names and literal keys are scanned too
excluded: Secret payloads and secretKeyRef/envFrom Secret dereference
configMapKeyRef/envFrom ConfigMap dereference; select a ConfigMap explicitly instead
downward API/resource references and variable substitution
logs, exec, kubelet/node/host paths, registry pulls and application execution
arbitrary discovery, custom URLs or selected names outside requested namespaces

fields: env[].valueFrom and envFrom are references, not observed literal values
native_contracts.assessment: Native v1 exact GET is sufficient for selected declared literal content only. It cannot supply effective expanded runtime environment, credential validity, serving state or referenced Secret payloads.
Literal text and valid UTF-8 decoded bytes are scanned. Overlapping data/binaryData keys, malformed maps, non-UTF8 bytes, partial/empty/oversized content remain UNKNOWN.

Minimum permission is namespace/resourceNames-scoped get, two exact reads per selected object; no list, get secrets, logs or exec needed for this check. Setup docs provide separate exact Pod/ConfigMap rules.

bounds.detector_timeout: at most half remaining bounded interval per engine; both run sequentially
bounds.deadline_semantics: Cancellation/deadline checked before requests and each stream chunk and before/after detectors. An in-flight bounded wait may finish after the remaining batch deadline; it cannot then yield complete evidence. Existing credential setup is outside the content inspection batch budget.
bounds.caller_shared_budgets: max_calls, max_resources, max_scopes and deadline/cancellation remain authoritative; skipped or truncated selections cannot prove clean.

security_assessment.transport: Existing Kubernetes authenticated verified-TLS pool, existing origin/path checks, plus temporary exact selected literal_paths allowlist. SDK update_params_for_auth supplies credentials; direct preload_content=False pool streaming avoids SDK error-body/deserialization retention and SDK retries/redirects. Exact method+host+path asserted by fake transport.
security_assessment.identity: Configured cluster binding plus native exact namespace/name/kind and stable opaque UID/resourceVersion; no suffix joins, discovery or effective cloud-identity claim.
security_assessment.redaction: Only HMAC locators, counts, engine statuses and constant read receipts survive. The UNION of detected values scrubs dict keys, strings, identities and locations across all collected native inventories and metadata before sealing. Literal content is never put in provider SDK/cache. SDK last_response is cleared after separately requested metadata jobs for authorized literal scans. Optional literal scans suppress AI access capture and namespace-bearing progress.
security_assessment.engines: Kingfisher1.4.0 offline detector only; TruffleHog3.92.5 stdin --no-verification --no-update and bounded output; no validator, verification, network update or download.
security_assessment.dedup: peaso.secret_scanning._fingerprint is reused unchanged for exact-value process-keyed HMAC across adapters. Actual Azure and K8s native fixture readers produce the same fingerprint for one canary. Multiple selected Pod/ConfigMap detections collapse into one final finding with multiple opaque locations.
security_assessment.status_rules: PASS only when every selection in the scoped collection is complete, stable, bound and scanned by both engines with no supported detection. FAIL indicates detected potential exposure only. Unavailable/missing/denied/partial/changed/unsupported/empty/unscanned/malformed data cannot prove clean; both-detector absence is never inferred from one missing engine.

def enabled(options):
    return (options.get('content_secret_scans') is True
        and isinstance(options.get('_content_secret_scan_kinds'), list)
        and KIND in options['_content_secret_scan_kinds'])

def selected_targets(options, scopes):
    if (not isinstance(options, dict) or ('content_secret_scans' in options
            and type(options['content_secret_scans']) is not bool)):
        raise Incomplete('invalid_selection')
    if OPTION not in options and not enabled(options):
        return []
    targets = options.get(OPTION)
    if (not isinstance(scopes, list) or not scopes or len(set(scopes)) != len(scopes)
            or any(not isinstance(s, str) or not _NAMESPACE.fullmatch(s) for s in scopes)
            or not isinstance(targets, list) or not 1 <= len(targets) <= 8):
        raise Incomplete('invalid_selection')
    seen = set()
    clusters = set()
    for target in targets:
        if (not isinstance(target, dict) or set(target) != {'cluster_id', 'namespace', 'kind', 'name'}
                or not isinstance(target['cluster_id'], str) or not 1 <= len(target['cluster_id']) <= 512
                or any(ord(c) < 33 or ord(c) > 126 for c in target['cluster_id'])
                or target['kind'] not in ('Pod', 'ConfigMap')
                or not isinstance(target['namespace'], str) or target['namespace'] not in scopes
                or not isinstance(target['name'], str) or not _NAME.fullmatch(target['name'])
                or any(not _NAMESPACE.fullmatch(part) for part in target['name'].split('.'))):
            raise Incomplete('invalid_selection')
        key = json.dumps(target, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
        if key in seen:
            raise Incomplete('duplicate_selection')
        seen.add(key)
        clusters.add(target['cluster_id'])
    if len(clusters) != 1:
        raise Incomplete('conflicting_cluster_selection')
    return deepcopy(targets)

def identity(target):
    return KIND + ':' + _fingerprint(json.dumps(target, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')))

def collect(reader, api, options, scopes, cluster):
    """Return safe selection metadata plus transient union-redaction callback state."""
    targets = selected_targets(options, scopes)
    authorized = enabled(options)
    metadata = {KIND + '_authorized': authorized, KIND + '_selection': {
        scope: [identity(t) for t in targets if t['namespace'] == scope] for scope in scopes},
        KIND + '_receipts': [], KIND + '_cluster_binding': _fingerprint(cluster or '')}
    state = {'deadline': time.monotonic() + MAX_SECONDS, 'bytes': 0, 'calls': 0}
    matches = set()
    original_pool = None
    client = getattr(getattr(api, 'api', api), 'api_client', None)
    pool = getattr(getattr(client, 'rest_client', None), 'pool_manager', None)
    from .k8s import _BoundedPool
    if isinstance(pool, _BoundedPool):
        original_pool = pool.literal_paths
        pool.literal_paths = frozenset(_path(t) for t in targets) if authorized else frozenset()
    try:
        for scope in scopes:
            selected = [t for t in targets if t['namespace'] == scope]
            rows = []
            complete = bool(authorized and selected)
            reason = 'complete' if complete else 'disabled_or_unselected'
            for target in selected if authorized else []:
                if reader.budget.max_items is not None and reader.total >= reader.budget.max_items:
                    complete, reason = False, 'resource_limit'
                    break
                ident = identity(target)
                marker = {'schema': SCHEMA, 'identity': ident, 'scope': scope, 'kind': target['kind'],
                    'complete': False, 'reason': 'unavailable', 'verification': 'not_attempted',
                    'parts': [], 'leaks': [], 'source_requests': [], 'literal_count': 0, 'reference_count': 0,
                    'cluster_binding': _fingerprint(cluster or '')}
                try:
                    if target['cluster_id'] != cluster:
                        raise Incomplete('cluster_identity_mismatch')
                    before = None
                    for ordinal in (1, 2):
                        document, byte_count = _read(reader, api, target, state)
                        extracted = _extract(document, target)
                        if before is not None and extracted != before:
                            raise Incomplete('native_object_changed')
                        before = extracted
                        ref = 'k8s-literal-read-' + str(len(metadata[KIND + '_receipts']) + 1)
                        metadata[KIND + '_receipts'].append({'id': ref, 'identity': ident, 'scope': scope,
                            'method': 'GET', 'route': 'exact_selected_native_object', 'status': 200,
                            'bytes': byte_count, 'ordinal': ordinal, 'identity_bound': True})
                        marker['source_requests'].append(ref)
                    payload, uid, version, count, references = before
                    _remaining(reader, state)
                    outcome = scan_content(payload, ident + '.literals', timeout=_remaining(reader, state) / 2,
                        _redact_values=matches.update)
                    _remaining(reader, state)
                    if (len(outcome['leaks']) > MAX_LEAKS or
                            sum(len(l['locations']) for l in outcome['leaks']) > MAX_LOCATIONS):
                        raise Incomplete('detector_output_limit')
                    marker.update(complete=outcome['complete'], reason='complete' if outcome['complete'] else 'detectors_incomplete',
                        parts=[{'part': 'literals', 'bytes': len(payload), 'engines': outcome['engines'], 'complete': outcome['complete']}],
                        leaks=merge_leaks(outcome['leaks']), literal_count=count, reference_count=references,
                        uid_binding=_fingerprint(uid), version_binding=_fingerprint(version))
                except Exception as exc:
                    # No response/error text, native path or credential reaches evidence.
                    marker['reason'] = str(exc) if isinstance(exc, Incomplete) else 'native_or_detector_unavailable'
                if not marker['complete']:
                    complete, reason = False, 'selected_content_incomplete'
                rows.append({'id': ident, MARKER: marker})
                reader.total += 1
            reader.collections.append({'type': KIND, 'scope': scope, 'service': 'kubernetes',
                'status': 'collected' if complete else 'partial' if rows else 'unknown', 'items': rows,
                **({} if complete else {'error': {'code': reason}})})
    finally:
        if original_pool is not None:
            pool.literal_paths = original_pool
    return metadata, matches

def redact_output(scopes, collections, metadata, matches):
    """Apply the union across ALL selected objects before snapshot/cache/export."""
    try:
        safe = redact_matches({'scopes': scopes, 'collections': collections, 'metadata': metadata}, matches)
        return safe['scopes'], safe['collections'], safe['metadata']
    finally:
        matches.clear()

def evaluate(item, index):
    try:
        ctx = index['context']
        scope, metadata = ctx['scope'], ctx['metadata']
        if ctx['provider'] != 'k8s' or metadata[KIND + '_authorized'] is not True:
            raise ValueError('authorization')
        own, = [r for r in index['collections'][KIND] if r.get('scope') == scope]
        if own['status'] != 'collected' or not isinstance(own['items'], list):
            raise ValueError('collection')
        selected = metadata[KIND + '_selection'][scope]
        if (not isinstance(selected, list) or not 1 <= len(selected) <= 8 or len(set(selected)) != len(selected)
                or any(not isinstance(s, str) or not re.fullmatch(KIND + ':[0-9a-f]{64}', s) for s in selected)
                or len(own['items']) != len(selected) or {r.get('id') for r in own['items']} != set(selected)
                or sum(r == item for r in own['items']) != 1):
            raise ValueError('selection')
        marker, ident = item[MARKER], item['id']
        if (set(marker) != {'schema', 'identity', 'scope', 'kind', 'complete', 'reason', 'verification',
                'parts', 'leaks', 'source_requests', 'literal_count', 'reference_count',
                'cluster_binding', 'uid_binding', 'version_binding'}
                or marker['schema'] != SCHEMA or marker['identity'] != ident or marker['scope'] != scope
                or marker['kind'] not in ('Pod', 'ConfigMap') or marker['complete'] is not True
                or marker['reason'] != 'complete' or marker['verification'] != 'not_attempted'
                or marker['cluster_binding'] != metadata[KIND + '_cluster_binding']
                or any(not isinstance(marker[k], str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}', marker[k])
                    for k in ('uid_binding', 'version_binding'))
                or type(marker['literal_count']) is not int or not 1 <= marker['literal_count'] <= MAX_LITERALS
                or type(marker['reference_count']) is not int or not 0 <= marker['reference_count'] <= 4096):
            raise ValueError('marker')
        refs, ledger = marker['source_requests'], metadata[KIND + '_receipts']
        if (not isinstance(refs, list) or len(refs) != 2 or len(set(refs)) != 2
                or not isinstance(ledger, list) or not 2 <= len(ledger) <= 16
                or any(not isinstance(ref, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'k8s-literal-read-[1-9][0-9]*', ref) for ref in refs)):
            raise ValueError('receipts')
        for ref, ordinal in zip(refs, (1, 2)):
            receipt, = [r for r in ledger if r.get('id') == ref]
            if (set(receipt) != {'id', 'identity', 'scope', 'method', 'route', 'status', 'bytes', 'ordinal', 'identity_bound'}
                    or receipt['identity'] != ident or receipt['scope'] != scope or receipt['method'] != 'GET'
                    or receipt['route'] != 'exact_selected_native_object' or type(receipt['status']) is not int
                    or receipt['status'] != 200 or receipt['identity_bound'] is not True
                    or type(receipt['ordinal']) is not int or receipt['ordinal'] != ordinal
                    or type(receipt['bytes']) is not int or not 1 <= receipt['bytes'] <= MAX_WIRE):
                raise ValueError('receipt')
        parts = marker['parts']
        if not isinstance(parts, list) or len(parts) != 1:
            raise ValueError('parts')
        part = parts[0]
        if (set(part) != {'part', 'bytes', 'complete', 'engines'} or part['part'] != 'literals'
                or part['complete'] is not True or type(part['bytes']) is not int
                or not 1 <= part['bytes'] <= MAX_CONTENT):
            raise ValueError('part')
        versions = {'kingfisher': KINGFISHER_VERSION, 'trufflehog': TRUFFLEHOG_VERSION}
        engines = part['engines']
        if (not isinstance(engines, list) or len(engines) != 2 or any(not isinstance(e, dict)
                or set(e) != {'engine', 'version', 'status'} or e.get('engine') not in versions
                or e.get('version') != versions.get(e.get('engine')) or e.get('status') != 'complete' for e in engines)
                or {e['engine'] for e in engines} != set(versions)):
            raise ValueError('engines')
        leaks = marker['leaks']
        if (not isinstance(leaks, list) or merge_leaks(leaks) != leaks or len(leaks) > MAX_LEAKS
                or sum(len(l['locations']) for l in leaks) > MAX_LOCATIONS
                or any(loc['path'] != ident + '.literals' for l in leaks for loc in l['locations'])):
            raise ValueError('leaks')
        observed = ('A likely secret was detected in selected Kubernetes literals. The value is hidden; offline detection did not validate the credential.' if leaks else
            'Both offline detectors completed without detecting a supported secret in selected Kubernetes literals. Coverage is limited to the observed Pod and ConfigMap literals; references were not dereferenced.')
        return ('FAIL' if leaks else 'PASS'), {'secret_leaks': deepcopy(leaks), 'credential_validation': 'not_attempted',
            'complete': True, 'coverage': 'selected_observed_literals_only', 'parts': deepcopy(parts),
            'literal_count': marker['literal_count'], 'reference_count': marker['reference_count'],
            'source_requests': list(refs), 'observed': observed}
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError, AttributeError, OverflowError):
        return 'UNKNOWN', {'observed': 'Selected Kubernetes literals were disabled, unsupported, incomplete or unbound. Secret absence could not be assessed.'}

def install():
    from pathlib import Path
    from . import CHECKS, register
    from .fixtures import CASES
    if any(c.id == CHECK for c in CHECKS):
        return
    declaration = DECLARATIONS[0]
    register(CHECK, 'k8s', 'hardening', KIND, declaration['title'], 'high',
        'security_configuration', declaration['remediation'], dependencies=[KIND])(evaluate)
    CASES[CHECK] = json.loads(Path(__file__).with_name(
        'k8s_literal_secret_review_20261020_fixtures.json').read_text()).get(CHECK, {})

def request(self, method, url, **kwargs):
        review_request = method == "POST" and self.allow_self_subject_access_review
        if method != "GET" and not review_request:
            raise ValueError("native inventory transport is read-only")
        target = urlsplit(url)
        path = target.path
        if (target.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not target.hostname
                or target.username is not None or target.password is not None or target.fragment
                or any(c in path for c in ("%", "\\")) or "//" in path
                or any(c.isspace() or ord(c) < 32 for c in url)
                or any(part in (".", "..") for part in path.split("/"))):
            raise ValueError("invalid native inventory target")
        if self.server:
            def origin(value):
                return (value.scheme, value.hostname, value.port or (443 if value.scheme == "https" else 80))
            base = self.server.path.rstrip("/")
            if origin(target) != origin(self.server) or (base and not path.startswith(base + "/")):
                raise ValueError("native inventory target differs from configured API server")
            path = path[len(base):]
        # The official SDK supplies GET pagination/negotiation query via fields.
        # Validate that eventual query too, before urllib3 appends it to the URL.
        fields_query = urlencode(kwargs.get("fields") or {}, doseq=True)
        query = "&".join(part for part in (target.query, fields_query) if part)
        if review_request:
            if (path != "/apis/authorization.k8s.io/v1/selfsubjectaccessreviews"
                    or query or not kwargs.get("body")):
                raise ValueError("unsupported access review request")
        elif (kwargs.get("body") is not None
                or not _inventory_read_path(path, query, kwargs.get("headers"))):
            raise ValueError("unsupported native inventory read path")
        kwargs.update(redirect=False, retries=False)
        return self.pool.request(method, url, **kwargs)

def collect_snapshot(request):
    connector = _request(request)
    emit_progress(phase="collecting", provider=connector["provider"], completed=0, total=None, resources=0, dynamic_total=True)
    options = connector.get("options", {})
    if "snapshot" in options:

### Optional selected literal-content secret scanning

This reader is off by default. Enable `options.content_secret_scans: true`, name
`k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indicators` in `checks`, and supply
`options.selected_k8s_literal_resources` with 1–8 unique exact selectors. Each
selector has exactly `cluster_id`, `namespace`, `kind` (`Pod` or `ConfigMap`) and
`name`. The namespace must be an explicit requested scope; `*` is not supported
for this reader. The cluster ID must equal the configured `auth.cluster_id` or
the collector's API-origin digest. Selectors cannot be URLs or contain path
escapes, wildcards or discovery instructions.

```json
{
  "checks": ["k8s.review.selected_literals.secret_indicators"],
  "connector": {
    "provider": "k8s",
    "scopes": ["team-a"],
    "auth": {"method": "context", "context": "review-context", "cluster_id": "review-cluster"},
    "options": {
      "content_secret_scans": true,
      "selected_k8s_literal_resources": [
        {"cluster_id": "review-cluster", "namespace": "team-a", "kind": "Pod", "name": "review-pod"},
        {"cluster_id": "review-cluster", "namespace": "team-a", "kind": "ConfigMap", "name": "review-config"}
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

The reader issues two exact native GETs per selected object through the existing
authenticated TLS transport, checks namespace/name/kind/API version, and requires
unchanged UID, resourceVersion and selected content between reads. It inspects
literal env values, command and args in regular, init and ephemeral containers,
and ConfigMap `data` plus UTF-8 text decoded from `binaryData`. Selected object identities, container/env names and literal
keys enter the same offline detector input so detected values copied into
identity fields cannot survive in retained metadata. Variable substitutions are
not evaluated. Secret/config-map env references, downward API values and
`envFrom` references are counted and excluded without dereference. It never reads
Secret payloads, logs, exec, node/kubelet/host files or registry images.

Minimum additional permission for this exact check is namespace-scoped `get` on
the selected Pod and ConfigMap resource names. No `list` or `get secrets` grant is
needed. For example, an administrator can bind this Role to the existing scanner
identity in `team-a`; remove unused resource rules and use the actual exact names:

```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: peaso-selected-literal-reader
  namespace: team-a
rules:
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["pods"]
    resourceNames: ["review-pod"]
    verbs: ["get"]
  - apiGroups: [""]
    resources: ["configmaps"]
    resourceNames: ["review-config"]
    verbs: ["get"]
```

There is no blanket enumeration. The hard ceiling is 16 native GET attempts,
2 MiB per response, 8 MiB total response bytes, 256 KiB detector input per
object, 64 KiB per literal, and 512 nonempty literals per object. The reader uses
a 60-second batch budget, cancellation and caller-supplied shared call/resource
limits; individual network waits are at most 10 seconds and can finish after the
remaining batch deadline, in which case the result stays incomplete. Both pinned
offline engines (Kingfisher 1.4.0 and TruffleHog 3.92.5) must finish. No credential
validation, verification request, detector download or network update is used.

Only redacted evidence, opaque HMAC locators, counts and safe read receipts enter
the snapshot. HMAC exact-value fingerprints use the same process key as the other
content readers, allowing repeated detections to merge without retaining the
value. The union of detected values scrubs identity and location fields across
the completed collection before caching/export; progress carries counts only,
and this optional scan does not capture live AI access. Denied, malformed,
changed, partial, unsupported, empty or incompletely scanned content stays
`UNKNOWN`; it cannot prove secret absence. A `PASS` covers only the selected
observed supported literals, and a `FAIL` indicates potential exposure without
proving the credential is valid or usable.

Native field contracts: [Pod v1](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/core/pod-v1/),
[ConfigMap v1](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/core/config-map-v1/),
and [RBAC resourceNames](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/rbac/#referring-to-resources).

remaining_limitations: Selection-bounded detection only, not cluster-wide secret absence or effective access. Read stability does not promise future configuration or full runtime environment values.
Both offline engines must succeed; supported pattern absence is not proof that arbitrary credentials or all encodings are absent. False positives remain possible; no credential is validated.
Unsupported binary encodings, empty/oversized inputs or detector output overflow are UNKNOWN, not truncated clean results. Secret references and other explicitly excluded surfaces are not read.
The configured cluster label is trusted connector context bound to the existing API origin; Kubernetes native GET does not independently attest an EKS/GKE/AKS cloud resource identity.

HMAC keys are process-local; independently started processes do not generate globally stable fingerprints. Retained native fixtures compare their stored bindings and remain evaluable without recomputing process-keyed identities.
